description:
It feels harmless to wait.
To scroll.
To overthink.
To tell yourself you’ll start when life calms down.

But that’s how years go by.

If you knew the next year would be hard… but it would completely change your life, would you do it?

Because a lot can happen in a year of focus.
Three years of consistency can put you in a different league.
Five years of stacking the right habits can change your last name.

Everything worth having usually costs something upfront.

The real question is not whether it’ll be hard.
It’s whether the hard you’re avoiding now becomes the harder life you live later.

Always love sitting down with my brother @lewishowes . Full episode is live now on YouTube — watch it on The School of @greatness or comment LEWIS and I’ll send it to you directly.
transcript: would you live the hard way for a year so you could live easier for a decade after? So what if you just acknowledge, the next year's gonna be hard, but I'm gonna make choices that I've never made. I'm gonna be more courageous than I've ever been. I'm gonna unlock that creativity. What if you were courageous, bold, made moves, and the next year was hard, but 12 months from now, it was a little less hard, and 24 months was amazing, and 36 months from now, you were living into who you're meant to be. But you just, you never know how, Ogmundino in his book, The World's Greatest Salesman, when he talks about, I will persist until I succeed. That's one of the 10 scrolls in The World's Greatest Salesman. And he talks about that you never know how many corners you have to go around until your success is on the other side. And how I translated that is, you might have to go through 10 failures, 10 question yourself, living on your sister's couch, and then the 11th thing, you found enough success to go forward.
